parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables authentication of the NTP server.

parameters.name: Certificate
parameters.description: Points to the certificate that must be used by the NTS-KE client.

parameters.name: NTSNTPServer
parameters.description: Points to a CSV list of NTP servers. A NTP server can either be specified as an IP address or a host name. When used the NTS-KE server will tell the remote NTS-KE client the NTP hostname or address of the NTP server(s) that should be used. This allows to separate the NTP server and NTS-KE server implementation.

object.description: This object contains parameters relating to enabling security for the NTP Server.
